question: Who among the following is a Nobel laureate, also known as the father of micro finance systems?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Yunus.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Yunus** is a **Nobel Prize winner** and also known as the **father of microfinance.**
 
• Microfinance refers to providing **small loans to people **who are unable to access traditional banking services, especially in developing countries.
 
• Muhammad Yunus pioneered this concept and founded** Grameen Bank in Bangladesh in 1983.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Amartya Sen** is an** Indian economist and philosopher **who won the Nobel Prize in Economics in **1998 **for his work on welfare economics.

 
 
• He is known for his contributions to the** study of social choice theory** and development economics.
 
 
 
• **Raghuram Rajan** is an Indian economist who served as the **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India** from** 2013 to 2016**.
 
 
• He is known for his work on** financial regulation and macroeconomics.**
 
 
 
• **Sandra Rothenberg** is an **American professor and researcher **who is known for her work on corporate **social responsibility and sustainability.**
 
 
• **​**She has written several books and articles on these topics.
